modifiedFiles.description: Refined numerical qualification status guard logic: added numeric type checks (NaN/Infinity), missing field checks, and conflict detection between top-level and nested numerical fields.
Added support for SECP_AUTHORITY_SECRET and SECP_AUTHORITY_KEY_VERSION environment variables for persistent key management across process boundaries.
Added subprocess CLI test execution (TB-05B), environment variable configuration, and updated TB-06 resultHash tamper tracking.

createdFiles.description: Standalone CLI process runner for out-of-process cold start evidence chain verification.
